summary: Enhance your skills with our Advanced Microsoft Excel Training Course. Master complex functions, data analysis, and automation to boost your career today!
lede: Advanced Excel training helps professionals who build, review, or interpret spreadsheet analysis create dependable outputs for recurring reporting and operational workflows. Participants practise structuring data, engineering and auditing formulas, and using Power Query, PivotTables, and the Data Model to prepare and analyse information. They also develop skills in scenario testing, dashboard design, and workbook controls for traceable results.
audienceIntro: This advanced Excel course is designed for professionals who build, review, refresh, or interpret spreadsheet-based analysis in recurring operational and reporting workflows.
prerequisites: You should have regular experience using Microsoft Excel formulas, worksheets, tables, sorting, filtering, and basic charts. Familiarity with functions such as IF, SUMIF, and VLOOKUP is recommended. You need a laptop with a current desktop edition of Microsoft Excel that supports Power Query, dynamic arrays, PivotTables, the data model, and Solver. Coding or programming is not required. VBA and Office Scripts are introduced at conceptual or guided operational level, while formula engineering, Power Query, PivotTables, DAX measures, scenario tools, and dashboards receive hands-on practice.
